js: window.__until = async (f, ms) => { const t0 = Date.now(); for (;;) { try { if (f()) return true; } catch {} if (Date.now() - t0 > ms) return false; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } }

name: row-lifts-together
js: window.__table.liftOf('books') > 0.9 && window.__table.liftOf('book.inferno') === 0

name: shelf-active
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.active && s.spread > 0.99 && s.open === null; }, 15000)

name: shelf-dom
js: window.__until(() => { return document.querySelector('#shelf .shelf-back') !== null && +getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('shelf')).opacity > 0.9; }, 15000)
window.__books.drive.scrollBy(0.18)

name: shelf-scrolled
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.scroll > s.min + 0.05; }, 15000)
window.__books.drive.hover('book.three-body')

name: shelf-hover-leans
js: window.__until(() => { const b = window.__books.state('book.three-body'); return window.__books.shelf().hovered === 'book.three-body' && b.shelf.z > 0.02 && b.shelf.pitch > 0.1; }, 15000)

name: shelf-caption
js: window.__until(() => { const c = document.querySelector('#shelf .shelf-caption'); return c.textContent.indexOf('The Three-Body Problem') === 0 && +getComputedStyle(c).opacity > 0.9; }, 15000)

name: book-open
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.open === 'book.three-body' && window.__table.state.focused === 'books' && document.getElementById('panel-title').textContent === 'The Three-Body Problem'; }, 15000)

name: esc-closes-book-stays-on-shelf
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.open === null && window.__table.state.focused === 'books' && document.getElementById('panel').hidden; }, 15000)

name: arrows-select
js: window.__until(() => { return window.__books.shelf().hovered === 'book.inferno'; }, 10000)

name: enter-opens
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.open === 'book.inferno' && document.querySelector('#panel figure img') !== null; }, 15000)

name: chevron-closes-book
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.open === null && window.__table.state.focused === 'books' && document.getElementById('panel').hidden; }, 15000)
window.__books.drive.hover('book.thinking-fast-slow')

name: kahneman-route
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.open === 'book.thinking-fast-slow' && document.querySelector('#panel .content img[src*="checker"], #panel .content svg, #panel .content .kahneman, #panel .content figure') !== null; }, 15000)

name: kahneman-closed
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.open === null && window.__table.state.focused === 'books' && document.getElementById('panel').hidden; }, 15000)
window.__table.state.music.isPlaying = true; window.__table.state.music.pause = () => { window.__pauseCalled = true; }
window.__books.drive.hover('book.pride-and-prejudice')

name: austen-paused
js: window.__until(() => { return window.__pauseCalled === true && window.__table.state.music.isPlaying === false; }, 15000)

name: austen-letter
js: window.__until(() => { return window.__austen && window.__austen.shown && document.querySelector('#panel .letter .hand em').textContent === 'Persuasion' && !document.getElementById('bubble'); }, 15000)

name: letter-folds
js: window.__until(() => { return !window.__austen.shown && !document.querySelector('#panel .austen-again').hidden; }, 15000)

name: pride-closed
js: window.__until(() => { const s = window.__books.shelf(); return s.open === null && window.__table.state.focused === 'books' && document.getElementById('panel').hidden; }, 15000)

name: esc-returns-to-table
js: window.__until(() => { return window.__table.state.focused === null && window.__table.info().mode === 'rest' && document.getElementById('shelf') === null; }, 20000)

name: books-restored
js: window.__until(() => { for (const id of window.__table.ids) { if (!id.startsWith('book.')) continue; const b = window.__books.state(id); if (Math.abs(b.motion.x) > 1e-4 || Math.abs(b.motion.lift) > 1e-4 || Math.abs(b.motion.yaw) > 1e-4) return false; } return true; }, 15000)
